t: This is the statue of Lord Trenchard, a Grade Two listed statue in Victoria Embankment Gardens, in front of the Ministry of Defence building. It shows Hugh Trenchard, the first Viscount Trenchard, a Marshal of the Royal Air Force who was instrumental in establishing the RAF and is described as its Father. The sculptor was William McMillan, a Scottish sculptor known for public statues across the United Kingdom. The architect Albert Richardson designed the setting. Richardson was a leading architect, teacher and writer, and a President of the Royal Academy.
